references.text: Here in Numbers we find the original census of Manasseh's descendants, including Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida - the same clans mentioned in Joshua 17:2.
The daughters of Zelophehad were descendants of Hepher, one of the clans mentioned in Joshua 17:2. This verse establishes the lineage through Manasseh.
First Chronicles gives a detailed genealogy of Manasseh's descendants, including Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida as mentioned in Joshua 17:2.
Abiezer, the first clan mentioned in Joshua 17:2, was Gideon's family from Ophrah.
The Abiezrites are called together by Gideon, showing the clan's continued significance in the tribe of Manasseh.
Abiezer is mentioned again as an important clan in Manasseh during Gideon's time.
